development_data: 2026-10-12 Kyoto R7-R12 only; not prospective evidence

metadata_inputs.quality_tier_policy: append-only official tier mappings for newly encountered race names; existing baseline mappings may not change during v3.1 holdout

holdout_start_rule: The first eligible Kyoto race whose valid source capture, odds snapshot and pre-result freeze all satisfy the frozen contract after created_at_jst is holdout race 1. Every subsequent eligible Kyoto race must be attempted chronologically and recorded in the attempt ledger until 20 scored FROZEN races are accumulated.
change_control: Any threshold or rescue-logic change creates v3.2 or later and starts a new holdout window.
integrity_note: The frozen snapshot preparer records source-page hashes. The frozen holdout wrapper verifies preparer/classifier/wrapper SHAs, baseline quality tiers, race identity, active horse-number set, eligibility, and the 15-25 minute pre-post market window. Every eligible race is additionally recorded in the attempt ledger as FROZEN or PRE_RESULT_DATA_FAILURE. The formal evaluator requires the scored race sequence to match the first FROZEN attempts and applies p<=0.05, candidate fraction<=0.65, and freeze success rate>=0.80.

formal_evaluation.primary_test: one-sided exact stratified random-addition rescue test

integrity_correction: Corrected the candidate-channel test blob SHA before any holdout race was attempted; no scientific threshold, eligibility, or decision rule changed.
source_sha_correction: Before any prospective holdout race, a real end-to-end test found the frozen snapshot preparer generated an invalid Git blob hash (literal backslash-zero instead of NUL). The one-line hashing fix and regression test were applied; no candidate-generation thresholds or formal decision gates changed.
postrace_integrity: Before accepting a score into the holdout ledger, scripts/v31_holdout.py register MUST receive --freeze, --result, --result-capture, --score and --attempt-ledger and invoke scripts/v31_validate_postrace.py. The validator re-parses the raw official JRA result capture through the frozen result preparer, requires exact reproduction of result.json, checks result timing/source hashes, recomputes candidate/recall arithmetic, and validates the prior FROZEN attempt. No score may be registered without this gate.
integrity_correction_2: Pre-holdout defensive fix: make independent post-race validation mandatory inside ledger registration instead of a voluntary separate command. No v3.1 candidate thresholds, odds window, eligibility or formal evaluation thresholds changed.
result_source_provenance: Pre-holdout defensive hardening: official target results are no longer entered as manual top-three numbers. scripts/v31_prepare_result.py accepts only official JRA result-page captures whose date, Kyoto venue and race number match race_id; formal registration re-parses the raw capture and verifies its SHA-backed result provenance. No candidate-generation, market-window, eligibility or formal decision thresholds changed.
integrity_correction_3: Pre-holdout correction: the full-pipeline integration test was updated to pass the now-required official result capture into ledger registration. This changes no production logic, candidate thresholds, eligibility, market window, or formal decision gates.
